shadows.name: hairline
shadows.purpose: Outlines night surfaces instead of lifting them; paper-line on paper.

motion.name: color
motion.purpose: Link, ghost and button color changes.

motion.name: state-crossfade
motion.purpose: Badge clear, error to ready, step captions.

motion.name: bar-fill
motion.purpose: Usage bar fills scale from the left.

motion.name: carry
motion.value: scroll progress p over 290vh (240vh narrow): lift 0.06-0.2, travel 0.18-0.78 cubic ease-out, set down 0.74-0.86, landed at 0.8, ink fade 0.86-0.98
motion.purpose: The one authored motion; drives data-lifted, data-landed, data-step, data-scrolled.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Carry collapses to its height, static stage at the landed end state, live ticker and scroll cue off, smooth scroll off.

narrative.overview:
Porter's macOS app lives on warm paper with terracotta and serif titles. The web renders that same world after hours: a deep plum lobby, darkened from the porter's uniform, where the app's paper cards glow like lit objects on a desk. Nothing on the night ground pretends to be the app; everything on paper is the app, rebuilt at its real scale with its real states (usage bars, the limit error, reset times).

Density is calm and editorial: wide sections on one shared rhythm, a two-column split of copy against an object, and one authored moment of motion. Depth comes from light, not from chrome: soft lamplight gradients in the plum, long diffuse shadows under the paper objects, and a brass line that marks the porter's route. Detail is brass; action is terracotta; status is the app's own green, orange and red.

The world takes its type from the app's serif titles, set in Gloock (Prata for Cyrillic, the native Mincho/Song/Myeongjo serif for CJK), with the Mac system face for everything read and SF Mono only for real paths and commands.
keyCharacteristics: Plum night ground (#1c1420) with radial lamplight in the uniform plum (#57406b).
App paper (#fffdf9 / #f5f0e8) for every object that represents Porter's UI.
One terracotta action, brass for detail and path, usage colors only for usage.
High-contrast serif display, system sans body, mono only for literal code.
One scroll-scrubbed signature moment; everything else is still.

rules.name: The Lit Object Rule
rules.body: Paper appears on the night ground only as an object from Porter's own UI (account card, session, panel, window, ledger). Paper is never a generic section background.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Terracotta fills exactly one kind of thing on the night ground: the download button. Every other accent on night is brass.

rules.name: The Usage Colors Rule
rules.body: Green, orange and red mean usage state, with the app's thresholds (under 75, 75 to 99, 100). They are never decoration. Orange is a bar fill, not text on paper.

rules.name: The One Weight Serif Rule
rules.body: Gloock is set at 400 only; hierarchy comes from size and color, never bold serif.

rules.name: The Script-Native Serif Rule
rules.body: Each language gets a display serif made for its script: Prata for Cyrillic; on ja, zh-Hans and ko pages the display stack swaps to Hiragino Mincho, Songti or AppleMyungjo, the CJK hero drops to clamp(2.3rem, 4.4vw, 4.4rem) at 1.12, and Japanese breaks by phrase.

rules.name: The Real Code Rule
rules.body: Monospace marks something the reader could type or find on disk. It is not a style.

rules.name: The Light Falls Off Rule
rules.body: Shadows are long, soft and pulled in by negative spread; no hard offsets, no colored shadows. On night, outline with an inset hairline rather than lifting.

dos: **Do** set every app object on paper at the app's real proportions, with real states and an "Example data" caption.
**Do** keep terracotta for the download action and brass for every other accent on night.
**Do** use the shared ease (cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1)) for every transition and keep motion to the carry plus small state changes.
**Do** give every language a display serif made for its script and test the hero headline in ja, zh-Hans, ko and ru.
**Do** outline night surfaces with an inset plum-line hairline and float paper objects on long, soft negative-spread shadows.
**Do** honor reduced motion by showing the end state, not a frozen midpoint.
donts: **Don't** use Claude or Anthropic marks, logos or trade dress; the bellhop is the only mascot.
**Don't** use green, orange or red for anything but usage state.
**Don't** set Gloock bold or use a second display face for Latin text.
**Don't** add a second scroll-driven or ambient motion moment; the carry is the page's one authored motion.
**Don't** use monospace for anything that is not a literal path, file or command.
**Don't** invent numbers: usage figures are labeled example data, and there are no counts, ratings or testimonials.
